name: research-session-recorder
description: Chrome extension for tracking and organizing research sessions

scripts.dev: npm run build:chrome && (vite build --watch & vite build --config vite.content.config.ts --watch & wait)
scripts.build:chrome: tsc && VITE_BROWSER=chrome vite build && VITE_BROWSER=chrome vite build --config vite.content.config.ts
scripts.build:firefox: tsc && VITE_BROWSER=firefox vite build && VITE_BROWSER=firefox vite build --config vite.content.config.ts
scripts.build: npm run build:chrome && npm run build:firefox
scripts.package:chrome: npm run build:chrome && cd dist/chrome && zip -qr ../research-session-recorder-chrome.zip .
scripts.package:firefox: npm run build:firefox && cd dist/firefox && zip -qr ../research-session-recorder-firefox.zip .
scripts.package:source: mkdir -p dist && git archive --format=zip -o dist/research-session-recorder-source.zip HEAD
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
